faqs.question: What standard applies to bottled water?
faqs.answer: IS 14543 (packaged drinking water, including mineral water). Also check FSSAI regulations, since FSSAI governs mandatory compliance for packaged food.

faqs.question: Do edible oils need BIS certification?
faqs.answer: Typically FSSAI-regulated. BIS standards exist (e.g., IS 14309, IS 11069) but check for any QCO before asserting mandatory BIS marking is required.
faqs.citation: FAD 13 - Oils And Oilseeds committee standards
